title: Polycam Camera JSON Schema
description: Camera parameters generated per frame when exporting in Polycam or Scan4D format

fx.description: The focal length on the x axis.

fy.description: The focal length on the y axis.

cx.description: The optical center offset on the x axis.

cy.description: The optical center offset on the y axis.

width.description: Resolution width of the RGB images.

height.description: Resolution height of the RGB images.

blur_score.description: Set to 1.0, as blurry frames are prerejected.

image_path.description: Relative path to the RGB image.

depth_path.description: Relative path to the associated depth map.

confidence_path.description: Relative path to the associated depth confidence map.

is_keyframe.description: True for sharp stillness keyframes (hi-res stills captured while the device was stationary). These frames may have a higher width/height than the video-stream frames.

sharpness.description: Measured keyframe sharpness: variance of the 3x3 Laplacian over the luma plane (higher = sharper). Only present on keyframes. Additive key — blur_score's assumed 1.0 semantics are unchanged.

exposure_duration_s.description: Camera exposure duration in seconds at keyframe capture. Only present on keyframes.

face.description: Present on synthetic cube faces reprojected from a 360° equirect still: which cube face this pinhole frame is. The bottom face (operator/rod) is never emitted.

camera_pose_source.description: Present on synthetic 360° cube faces: how the pose was derived. 'rig_prior' = mechanical-prior rig extrinsic on a leveling-validated camera (Theta X); 'rig_prior_unvalidated_leveling' = same prior on a camera whose zenith correction exists but is not yet device-validated (Theta Z1). Cameras with unknown leveling emit no faces at all. A solved hand-eye calibration value replaces these later.

still_source.description: Present on synthetic 360° cube faces: the source camera's reported model string (e.g. 'RICOH THETA X').
